en.name: Sensate
en.ability: Each night, the Demon chooses an alive player (not you): the Demon & you learn their character.

revisions.v1: Each night, the Demon chooses an alive player (not you): the Demon & you learn their character.

en.firstNightReminder: Wake the Demon to choose a player; show them that player's character token. Put the Demon to sleep. Wake the Sensate & show them that player's character token.
en.otherNightReminder: Wake the Demon to choose a player; show them that player's character token. Put the Demon to sleep. Wake the Sensate & show them that player's character token.

zh.name: 超感者
zh.ability: 每个夜晚，恶魔要选择一名除你以外的存活玩家：恶魔和你会得知他是什么角色。

revisions.v1: 每个夜晚，恶魔要选择一名除你以外的存活玩家：恶魔和你会得知他是什么角色。

zh.firstNightReminder: 唤醒恶魔让他选择一名玩家，告知恶魔该玩家是什么角色。让恶魔入睡，再唤醒超感者告知该玩家是什么角色。
zh.otherNightReminder: 唤醒恶魔让他选择一名玩家，告知恶魔该玩家是什么角色。让恶魔入睡,再唤醒超感者告知该玩家是什么角色。
